question: Do the Q6-RGS quadratic functional-calculus coefficients persist under independent spectral refinement?
current_result_scope: Unique degree-at-most-two interpolation on the selected rank-three sector; stored-array numerical identity only.
reasons_blocked: Three spectral pairs determine three quadratic coefficients and provide no held-out validation.
K0 provenance lacks its exact generating cell, inputs, and a certified identification of its 188D coordinate basis with the geometric tangent basis.
The existing Q6 embedding audit reports nonzero coupling of K0 between the embedded 64D sector and its 124D complement.
T_transport depends on PG and a polar construction, so it is not an independent held-out operator.
admissibility_requirements: Independently generated refined Laplacian L_h and RGS operator K_h with archived source lineage.
Certified basis map U_h and invariant-subspace leakage measurements.
At least three fitting nodes and one distinct held-out spectral node.
At least two independent refinement levels with coefficient drift and conditioning reported.
Polynomial degree not fixed in advance; compare constant, linear, quadratic, and higher-degree models.
claims_not_made: No independent refinement test has passed.
No coefficient invariance theorem is established.
No continuum or physical law is inferred.
